rules.statement: The title of the vendor before the putative sale was defective, and the subsequent acquisition of title by the vendor cures the defect, allowing the purchaser to rely on the subsequent title and resist any attempt by the vendor to eject them.
rules.supporting_quote: When it was gazetted, the defect was cured and the absolute title of the land could be considered to have passed over to the vendee in view of the maxim Exceptio Rei Vinditae Et Traditae
